items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Mm.' to the interviewer's statement that 'Danille was with him then'. The interviewee does not claim any personal interaction or relationship with Danille.

ctx.x: Because he made two trips to Danville back in the spring of 46.

I know. With Danille. With Danille. Danille was with him then, yes. And, uh, it was incredible. We had never—Nicks had been the only place that I'd ever heard live jazz before. I was early twenties. And suddenly walking into this room and hearing this power coming off the bandstand, with Bunk and George cutting through and filling in and Jim bringing up the bottom. And, uh, later during that—during the season they were there, I got a chance to speak to Bunk. And I remember—he's very nice. He was standing over in…
